conditions.displayName: 5xx share of all requests over 5 min above 2%

documentation.content:
More than 2% of requests to claude-code-recorder answered 5xx for five minutes. Every 5xx on /v1/events keeps a batch on a laptop and the whole fleet retries against the same instance, so this is the alert that precedes a capture backlog.

First: `gcloud logging read 'resource.labels.service_name="claude-code-recorder" AND httpRequest.status>=500' --limit=20 --freshness=1h` and note the route. Then the cause: `gcloud logging read 'resource.labels.service_name="claude-code-recorder" AND jsonPayload.message="ingest request failed"' --limit=20 --freshness=1h` grouped by `jsonPayload.op` (upsert events = the database; verify device = the database; read body = an oversized batch). If a deploy just landed, roll back first and diagnose second: `gcloud run services update-traffic claude-code-recorder --region=<region> --to-revisions=<previous>=100`.

Runbook: examples/deploy-gcp/README.md#runbook-ingest-5xx
